name: Kunsthalle Wien
known: Directors: Gerald Matt (1996 to 2012), Nicolaus Schafhausen (2012 to 2019), the collective WHW (2019 to 2024) and Michelle Cotton since summer 2024 (Wikipedia).

name: Leopold Museum
known: Founded by the collectors Elisabeth and Rudolf Leopold, who gathered more than 5,000 exhibits over five decades.
Wikipedia's Portrait of Wally article says the Austrian government bought 5,400 works for $500 million in 1994 and named Leopold director for life.

name: MAK - Museum of Applied Arts
known: Founded in 1863 under Emperor Franz Joseph I with Rudolf von Eitelberger as first director.
Lilli Hollein has directed it since 2021, its first female director (Wikipedia).
Support groups: the MAK Art Society (MARS), the MAK Director's Cercle and International Friends of the MAK Vienna, a US 501(c)(3) organisation (annual report).

The Kuratorium (board) to the end of 2024 was chaired by Astrid Gilhofer; members include Elisabeth Gürtler, Claudia Oetker, Barbara Glück of the Mauthausen Memorial, Martin Böhm of Dorotheum, and representatives of two federal ministries, the public service union and the staff council (annual repor
The International MAK Advisory Board, chaired by Gertie Gürtler, lists Ronald S.

name: Villa Beer
known: Operator: Villa Beer Foundation gemeinnützige GmbH and Villa Beer Betriebs GmbH, both wholly owned by the XELAOS Private Foundation; managing directors Trierenberg and Katharina Egghart (villabeer.com legal notice).
Names its managing directors, sole shareholder and sponsors (Bundesdenkmalamt, Stadt Wien Kultur, Beijerstiftelsen) on its site.

name: mumok
known: Werner Hofmann was the founding director.
Directors: Karola Kraus from 2010 and Fatima Hellberg from 1 October 2025 (German Wikipedia).

name: Baku Museum of Modern Art
known: Aida Mahmudova has been its director since 2012.
She is also the founder of YARAT, the Baku contemporary art organisation (Wikipedia, Aida Mahmudova page).

Wikipedia also describes a wider "eco-cultural zone" conceived by Thomas Krens, former Guggenheim Foundation director, and planned to include a Frank Gehry skyscraper and a walkway over the Caspian Sea.
A ruling-family foundation is its only known funder; the director since 2012 is Aida Mahmudova, founder of YARAT.

name: National Art Gallery of The Bahamas
known: It opened on 7 July 2003 with three exhibitions, including the Inaugural National Exhibition curated by Erica James (the gallery's history page).
Historian Gail Saunders was founding chair and led the committee through the building's restoration.
Director since January 2025: Maelynn Ford (Wikipedia).
Board: John Cox (chair), Vaughn Roberts (vice chair), Patrice Williams (secretary), Maelynn Ford (executive director), Ivoine Ingraham, Kishan Munroe and Royann Dean.
Ex officio members include the Director of Culture, the Director General of Tourism and the director of the Antiquities, Monuments and Museums Corporation.

name: RAK Art Foundation
known: Non-profit art foundation in Riffa, in the centre of Bahrain, housed in the restored childhood home of its founder, Rashid Al Khalifa (Identity, Lemma Shehadi, 15 June 2022).
Founder Rashid Al Khalifa, born in Riffa in 1952, is an artist, patron and collector who founded the Bahrain Arts Society in 1983 (foundation website).
It occupies the founder's childhood home, which he acquired from his family in 2014 (foundation website, Identity).
The about page names only the founder Rashid Al Khalifa.

name: Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy
known: Wikipedia's infobox lists Sheikh Mujibur Rahman as founder.
Its government portal lists the director general, officers, projects, laws and notices.
